name: TinyClaw Self-Improvement
description: Reads own performance history, identifies weakness, proposes campaign improvement via PR
process: Read your performance history from Setec key 'remotejuggler/campaigns/tc-proof-of-life/history'
Analyze trends: success rate, tool call efficiency, duration
Identify ONE specific improvement to the tc-proof-of-life campaign
Fetch the current campaign JSON from github (test/campaigns/tinyclaw/tc-proof-of-life.json)
Create a branch, patch the campaign JSON with your improvement, create a PR
Report your proposed change and expected improvement in __findings__
Write a __memory__ reflection about what you changed and why
